Resolves #20371

🌿 The registry and the socket part at the seam that was always there, so "loading the AI client dials a bridge" stops being true.

`ai.Client` builds its registry (write guard, undo stack, six services, prefix map) and no longer dials. The App boot decides through `resolveAiClientBoot`: it starts the transport when `useAiClient` resolves true, in any of its three forms. The test-only `allowAiClientInTests` flag boots the registry alone, reached through `handleTestRequest`, which refuses before dispatch without the flag or a full `(agentId, sessionId)` pair. Console lines are buffered only for a started transport. `connect()` is idempotent, because a SharedWorker's later window registrations call it again, and `destroy()` now frees what the client creates.

Related: #20370 (epic, from D#18775). Intake: same-session ticket; stage 2 is recorded on #20371 ([6667480333](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20371#issuecomment-6667480333)).

Evidence: L2 (unit specs, including fresh-process probes of the client and the boot decision, plus the engine-tier e2e `AiClientLateBridge.spec.mjs` run locally at this head) → L2 required (every AC of #20371 is observable in unit or engine e2e).

## Deltas from ticket
- **`destroy()` is new.** AC-5's teardown had no destructor to test. It now unsubscribes the worker events and destroys the services, the write guard, the undo stack and a started socket.
- **The log buffer stays inside `Client.mjs`.** The `logs` getter hands `worker/Base.mjs`'s console bridge a throwaway array when no transport has started, so the bridge is untouched and the three production touchpoints hold.
- **`resolveAiClientBoot` is an App method.** The pre-commit guard refuses module-scope functions beside a class. The ConfigBase spec's facade receiver gains that method, because it drives `onRegisterNeoConfig` directly.
- `isWriterPair` is shared by `handleAgentDisconnected` and `handleTestRequest`; before, the check was inline.

## Test Evidence
- Falsifier: `ClientTransportSeam.spec.mjs` against `dev`'s `Client.mjs` fails 7 of 7: a socket at import, lines retained, three dials for two calls, no `handleTestRequest`.
- `AiClientLateBridge.spec.mjs` (engine e2e, local): 5/5.
- agent-preflight is not hosted in this repository; the baseline jobs run in CI.
